newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Wednesday renewed her offer for dialogue with the leader of the opposition Begum Khaleda Zia on all contentious issues.
The government has asked all ministries to aviod increase of expenses of revenue budget in the current fiscal year (1996-97).

Officials of the Ministry of Water Resources of India will reach Dhaka early next week to negotiate with their Bangladesh counterparts on the measures to save the four-month-old Indo-Bangla Ganges water sharing accord.
Dhaka on Wednesday urged the SAARC countries to consider a regional ban on trans-boundary movement of hazardous waste.
Singapore Foreign Minister S Jaya Kumar will pay a three-day official visit to Bangladesh from April 13.
South Korea has agreed to consider Bangladesh's proposal for taking more manpower and reducing the trade gap between the two countries.
A team of health researchers has recommended launching of a comprehensive awreness programme on AIDS in rural areas where knowledge about the killer disease is extremely low.
Russian envoy in Dhaka said on Wednesday that his country was willing to help Bangladesh in power generation sector.
